newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total confident of 12 pct ROE by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Total confident of 12 pct ROE by 2000.

text.p: Total SA told its shareholders on Wednesday it was confident of reaching a previously stated goal of 12 percent return on equity by the year 2000.

"In 1996 we achieved return on equity of more than 10 percent, helped it is true by a favourable oil market and we are ahead of schedule on the basis of our (oil) market reference calculation...," chairman Thierry Desmarest told a shareholders' meeting.
"We are now looking for 12 percent return on equity by the year 2000 using the same prudent oil market calculation," he said.
He said he was confident the target would be reached because of a four billion franc rise in operating profit which Total says it expects between 1997 and 1999.
He reiterated the group planned to expand investments to 18 billion francs in 1997 from 16 billion francs last year.
